papers.title: Real-time observation of a coherent lattice transformation into a high-symmetry phase
papers.abstract: Excursions far from their equilibrium structures can bring crystalline solids through collective transformations including transitions into new phases that may be transient or long-lived. Direct spectroscopic observation of far-from-equilibrium rearrangements provides fundamental mechanistic insight into chemical and structural transformations, and a potential route to practical applications, including ultrafast optical control over material structure and properties. However, in many cases photoinduced transitions are irreversible or only slowly reversible, or the light fluence required exceeds material damage thresholds. This precludes conventional ultrafast spectroscopy in which optical excitation and probe pulses irradiate the sample many times, each measurement providing information about the sample response at just one probe delay time following excitation, with each measurement at a high repetition rate and with the sample fully recovering its initial state in between measurements. Using a single-shot, real-time measurement method, we were able to observe the photoinduced phase transition from the semimetallic, low-symmetry phase of crystalline bismuth into a high-symmetry phase whose existence at high electronic excitation densities was predicted based on earlier measurements at moderate excitation densities below the damage threshold. Our observations indicate that coherent lattice vibrational motion launched upon photoexcitation with an incident fluence above 10 mJ/cm2 in bulk bismuth brings the lattice structure directly into the high-symmetry configuration for tens of picoseconds, after which carrier relaxation and diffusion restore the equilibrium lattice configuration.

llm.relevance_to_user: 该论文涉及铋晶体中的光致相变，与生物医用材料、髋关节植入物或增材制造完全不相关。
llm.why_not_core: This paper studies ultrafast phase transitions in bismuth using spectroscopy; it has no connection to biomedical implants, additive manufacturing, mechanical testing, or any biomechanical modeling.

summary_zh.motivation: 观察远离平衡态的晶体结构转变机制
summary_zh.method: 使用单次实时测量方法探测光致相变
summary_zh.result: 观察到铋从低对称相到高对称相的相干晶格转变
summary_zh.validation: 通过超快光谱实验验证相变的存在

summary_en.motivation: To directly observe far-from-equilibrium structural transformations in crystals via ultrafast spectroscopy.
summary_en.method: A single-shot real-time measurement method was used to capture the photoinduced phase transition in bismuth.
summary_en.result: Coherent lattice vibrations drive bismuth into a high-symmetry phase persisting for tens of picoseconds.
summary_en.validation: Experimental ultrafast spectroscopy measurements confirmed the phase transition above 10 mJ/cm² fluence.

papers.title: Selective laser melting of fused silica: Interdependent heat transfer and powder consolidation
papers.first_author_affiliation: Moscow State University of Technology “STANKIN”, Vadkovsky per. 3a, 127055 Moscow, Russia

corresponding_authors.name: A.V. Gusarov
corresponding_authors.affiliation: Institute of Photonic Technologies (LPT), Friedrich-Alexander-Universität Erlangen-Nürnberg, Konrad-Zuse-Str. 3-5, 91052 Erlangen, Germany

papers.venue: International Journal of Heat and Mass Transfer

llm.relevance_to_user: 该论文研究熔融石英的选择性激光熔化，不涉及生物医用金属植入物或应力遮挡等主题。
llm.why_not_core: This paper studies selective laser melting of fused silica (glass) for optical applications, not metallic biomedical implants. It contains no LPBF of Ti6Al4V or other biomedical alloys, no mechanical testing, no porous structures, no stress shielding analysis, and no osseointegration assessment.

summary_zh.motivation: 研究选择性激光熔化熔融石英的热传递与粉末固结相互作用。
summary_zh.method: 建立热传递与粉末固结耦合模型。
summary_zh.result: 揭示了工艺参数对致密化的影响。

summary_en.motivation: To investigate the interdependent heat transfer and powder consolidation during selective laser melting of fused silica.
summary_en.method: A coupled model of heat transfer and powder consolidation was developed.
summary_en.result: The influence of process parameters on densification was revealed.
